items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I was going to ask you about Guy Kelly, too. ... Well, we had a guy out of Baton Rouge named Guy Kelly. ... I think just before Guy Kelly left Baton Rouge he played with Toots Johnson.

ctx.x: But he was one of the best musicians to come out of Baton Rouge. Also, while you mention Red Allen as a native who if it wasn't for Louis, he'd have been the greatest... Well, we had a guy out of Baton Rouge named Guy Kelly.
I was going to ask you about Guy Kelly, too.
